title: bug: create_epic silently turns a bad or ARCHIVED status into PLANNED and stores order unchecked, where update_epic refuses both with INVALID_INPUT, and one string order then gives every later default-order epic NaN in memory and null on disk
description:
Filed by defect hunt #7 (task-44785c82, architect-1dd28c7c). Reproduced on moe/work-2026-10-24 22348856; the files are unchanged at c89e4c59.

PROBLEM (packages/moe-daemon/src/):
- Sibling update_epic runs StateManager.updateEpic (state/StateManager.ts:1287), which calls validateEpicUpdates (state/validators.ts):
  - status must be PLANNED, ACTIVE, COMPLETED or ARCHIVED (:586-588);
  - order must be an integer from 0 to MAX_SAFE_INTEGER (:589-591);
  - anything else is refused with INVALID_INPUT.
- Member create_epic (tools/createEpic.ts:38) runs StateManager.createEpic (:1245-1279):
  - Only epicRails goes through validateEpicUpdates (:1255).
  - status is `sanitizeEnum(input.status, ['PLANNED','ACTIVE','COMPLETED'], 'PLANNED')` (:1256-1257). Both "BOGUS" and "ARCHIVED" silently become PLANNED, though createEpic.ts:18's schema advertises "PLANNED, ACTIVE, COMPLETED or ARCHIVED".
  - order is `input.order ?? this.nextEpicOrder()` (:1268) with no check, so "abc" and -5 are written to the epic file.
  - The board's /ws CREATE_EPIC goes through the same state.createEpic.
- Cascade: nextEpicOrder (:1477-1481) is `Math.max(...epics.map(e => e.order)) + 1`. After one string order, every later create_epic that omits order gets NaN, which JSON writes as null.

EVIDENCE: repros at /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-44785c82/A/createEpic.validation.test.ts and createEpic.orderCascade.test.ts, run in a git-archive snapshot (/tmp/hunt-44785c82-A/packages/moe-daemon):
`LOG_LEVEL=silent npx vitest run src/tools/createEpic.validation.test.ts src/tools/createEpic.orderCascade.test.ts`
- The update_epic baseline passes: it refuses BOGUS, "abc" and -5.
- FAIL "create_epic answers the same inputs the same way": {"bogusStatus":{"refused":false,"status":"PLANNED","order":2},"stringOrder":{"refused":false,"status":"PLANNED","order":"abc"},"negativeOrder":{"refused":false,"status":"PLANNED","order":-5}}
- FAIL "create_epic keeps the ARCHIVED status its schema advertises (or refuses it), never PLANNED": {"refused":false,"status":"PLANNED","order":2}
- FAIL "a later default-order epic still gets a finite numeric order on disk": "in memory NaN, on disk null"

FIX DIRECTION:
- In StateManager.createEpic, validate a supplied status and order through validateEpicUpdates, as epicRails already is: refuse with INVALID_INPUT, never coerce. Keep the defaults when they are omitted (PLANNED, nextEpicOrder()).
- Decide ARCHIVED explicitly: accept it as update_epic does, or refuse it and fix createEpic.ts:18's description.
- Epic rail (backward-compatible with existing .moe/ state): make nextEpicOrder ignore a non-finite order already on disk, so an existing bad epic file can't poison it. Do not rewrite such files.

FILES:
- packages/moe-daemon/src/state/StateManager.ts (createEpic and nextEpicOrder only)
- packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/createEpic.ts (schema text, only if ARCHIVED is refused)
- new test files adopted from the two repros
definitionOfDone: In a git-archive snapshot outside the shared checkout, `npx vitest run src/tools/createEpic.validation.test.ts src/tools/createEpic.orderCascade.test.ts` (the hunt repros, adopted) passes. create_epic refuses status "BOGUS" and order "abc" / -5 with INVALID_INPUT, as update_epic does. "ARCHIVED" is either kept or refused, never turned into PLANNED. The next default order is a finite number, and the same number is on disk.

Omitted status and order still give PLANNED and nextEpicOrder(). A test loads an epic file that already holds a non-numeric order and shows the next default order stays finite, without rewriting that file.
In that snapshot, `npx vitest run src/tools/createEpic.test.ts src/tools/updateEpic.test.ts src/state/StateManager.test.ts src/state/validators.test.ts` stays green.
